description: Changes an illustrated story that's already made: the words of one scene, or what its picture shows. With no scene it lists the scenes, each with its number, words and what its picture shows. Nothing is drawn or recorded here and nothing is charged: when the changes are in and they've said to make them, call "story" with go: true.

picture.description: What the scene's picture should show, in plain words

scene.description: The scene's number, from the list

second_picture.description: The same for the scene's second picture, when the list shows it has one

words.description: The scene's new words, exactly as they will be said

name: edit_story
title: Change an illustrated story
